adapterMissing.zh-CN: 通知 adapter 命令不可用：{command}。本次会话已停用系统通知。
adapterMissing.en-US: Notification adapter command is unavailable: {command}. System notifications are disabled for this session.

sendFailed.zh-CN: 通知 adapter 执行失败：{command}（{reason}）。本次会话已停用系统通知。
sendFailed.en-US: Notification adapter failed: {command} ({reason}). System notifications are disabled for this session.

configInvalid.zh-CN: 通知配置读取失败：{path}（{reason}）。已使用默认配置。
configInvalid.en-US: Failed to read notification config: {path} ({reason}). Default configuration is being used.

configCommandUsage.zh-CN: 用法：/config:notifications（打开配置菜单）或 /config:notifications reset（恢复默认值）

configCommandInteractiveOnly.zh-CN: 通知配置需要在 TUI 中修改；请在交互式 Pi 会话中执行命令。
configCommandInteractiveOnly.en-US: Notification configuration requires the TUI; run this command in an interactive Pi session.

configDescEnabled.zh-CN: 关闭后不再发送任何系统通知。
configDescEnabled.en-US: When off, no system notifications are sent.

configDescCommand.zh-CN: PATH 中可执行的通知命令，例如 terminal-notifier 或 notify-send。
configDescCommand.en-US: Notification command on PATH, such as terminal-notifier or notify-send.

configDescArgs.zh-CN: 逗号分隔的 argv 参数，可用 {title}、{subtitle}、{message} 占位。
configDescArgs.en-US: Comma-separated argv arguments; {title}, {subtitle} and {message} are substituted.

configDescTimeout.zh-CN: 单次通知命令的最长执行时间。
configDescTimeout.en-US: Longest time a single notification command may run.
